body: American Samoais a group of islands east of Fiji, located in the Pacific Ocean. Since it is a US overseas territory, for country streak purposes, it is counted as the US.

The general landscape consists ofgreen, tropicalmountains with many palm trees. Small roads are often made ofconcrete. Most houses are one storey, and have a simple box design. Plainmetal sheetroofs are also very common.
A slightlyrusted blacktruck bed can be seen on the main island of Tutuila. This is the most common car that will be seen as it has the most coverage.
The front of asilver-greytruck with side mirrors can be seen on Manu’a and Olosega, which are connected by a bridge. See below for more information.
The front of a similar truck can be seen on the easternmost covered island of Tau. However, the truck will beglossy black, with side mirrors visible.
Thesingle-lanebridge, connecting the islands of Manu’a and Olosega, can be easily recognized by the thin wire guardrail, with the two islands on either side of the bridge.
Ofu Airport is small with aconcreterunway. The Google Car covering it has twoorange strapson the roof. Many palm trees can also be seen on the other side of the runway.
